name: Estonia — employment (tööleping)

changelog.summary: 2026: income tax 22% with the flat 700 EUR monthly tax-free amount (776 EUR at pension age); unemployment insurance 1.6% / 0.8%; funded pension 2%, 4% or 6%; social tax 33% with the 886 EUR monthly minimum.

emta-2026.title: EMTA, 'Maksumuudatused 2026. aastal' (27.11.2025) and 'Maksuvaba tulu arvestamine' — 22%; 700 eurot kuus (vanaduspensionieas 776); avaldus ainult ühele tööandjale; maksuvaba tulu kuni töötasu väljamakse ulatuses; kuumäär 886 eurot, miinimum 292,38 eurot; töötuskindlustus 1,6% / 0,8%; kogumispension 2%, 4% või 6%; maksustamine on kassapõhine (detsembri 2025 töötasu jaanuaris 2026 väljamaksmisel 2026. aasta määrad)

employee.description: Monthly tax-free amount from the employee's written application (TuMS § 42 lg 1): up to 700 EUR (0 without an application; one employer only, lg 2). From the year of reaching old-age pension age up to 776 EUR less what the pension already uses (§ 23^5, § 42 lg 1^3)
The employee reaches or has reached old-age pension age in this tax year (TuMS § 23^5): the tax-free amount may be up to 776 EUR
No employee unemployment insurance: from the month after reaching old-age pension age or being granted an early or flexible old-age pension (TKindlS § 42 lg 1 p 1); the employer's 0.8% remains
Mandatory funded pension (II pillar) contribution: 2%, or 4% or 6% if chosen (KoPS § 9); NONE if the employee is not a contributor
The employee also works for another employer: the social tax minimum is then paid only by the employer applying the tax-free amount (SMS § 2 lg 2^1)

The social tax minimum does not apply (SMS § 2 lg 4): shortened working time under TLS § 43 lg 4 or 6, parent of a child under 3 or of three or more children under 19, RaKS § 5 lg 4 p 5, within 12 months of hiring after at least six months registered unemployed, state pension recipient or partial/no work ability, local council member

Social tax minimum base in EUR replacing 886: for a month in which the employee started or left, or refused work under TLS § 19, 886 x calendar days worked / 30 (SMS § 2 lg 3; määrus nr 17 § 6); with another employer's pay certified, 886 less that pay (SMS § 2 lg 2^2; määrus nr 17 § 5)
The state pays social tax for this employee with partial or no work ability on the employer's application (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5) — not supported

steps.message: Estonian payroll is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template
Employees for whom the state pays social tax (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5) are not supported by this template
The monthly tax-free amount is at most 700 EUR (TuMS § 42 lg 1), or 776 EUR from the year of reaching old-age pension age (§ 23^5)
The employee started or left during the month: the social tax minimum is prorated by calendar days worked / 30 (SMS § 2 lg 3; määrus nr 17 § 6), so set the employee's socialTaxMinimumBase

limitations: Employment contracts paid monthly in EUR in 2026, one payment per employee per month; taxation follows the payment date (EMTA: kassapõhine), and the tax-free amount and the social tax minimum are applied to this payment. A second run in the same month would apply them again.

The tax-free amount, pension age, the end of employee unemployment insurance, the funded-pension rate, other employment and the social tax minimum exemptions are entered per employee from the employee's application and the registers; they are not checked.

In a month the employee started or left (or refused work under TLS § 19), the prorated social tax minimum base (886 x calendar days / 30, määrus nr 17 § 6) must be entered; unpaid leave agreed by the parties does not reduce the minimum (SMS § 2 lg 3 p 1). The minimum belongs to the month containing the agreed pay day (määrus nr 17 § 2); pay made earlier or later than agreed (§ 3-4) and the final settlement (§ 7) are not reconciled across months.

Not modelled: the state-paid social tax for employees with partial or no work ability (SMS § 6 lg 1 p 5, refused), fringe benefits (erisoodustused), III pillar contributions paid by the employer, non-residents, seafarers and board members' fees, and payments exempt from social tax (SMS § 3) such as the employer's sick pay for days 1-8.
Contributions and the tax are rounded to the cent, half up, per line (TKindlS § 42 lg 3; EMTA examples).
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the consolidated acts, the 2026 State Budget Act and Government regulation nr 78/2025; the cases are derived from them.

testCases.name: 2,000 EUR with the tax-free amount and 2% pension
testCases.evidence: UI 32.00, pension 40.00, (2000 - 32 - 40 - 700) x 22% = 270.16; social tax 660.00, employer UI 16.00. TuMS § 4, 23, 23^5, 42; SMS § 2, 7; 2026 State Budget Act (886); VV määrus nr 78/2025 (1.6% / 0.8%); KoPS § 9; amounts from build_template.py expected_lines()

testCases.name: minimum wage 946 EUR from April
testCases.evidence: Minimum wage 946 EUR from 1 April 2026 (EMTA); above the 886 EUR base, so no top-up. TuMS § 4, 23, 23^5, 42; SMS § 2, 7; 2026 State Budget Act (886); VV määrus nr 78/2025 (1.6% / 0.8%); KoPS § 9; amounts from build_template.py expected_lines()

testCases.name: part-time 600 EUR: social tax on the 886 EUR minimum

testCases.name: part-time parent of a child under 3: no minimum
